AMN_2024q4.implicit_reasons: Revenue of $687.5 million beat the Zacks Consensus Estimate by 2.6% but fell 19.4% from $853.46 million a year earlier, with steep declines in the Nurse and Allied Solutions segment (down 30.4%) and Technology and Workforce Solutions (down 10.7%) partly offset by growth in Physician and Leadership Solutions (up 13.2%). AMN's fourth-quarter guidance of $685 million-$705 million in revenue, while above the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $668.2 million, still implied a 14-16% year-over-year decline and continued weakness in the majority of segments, which Zacks called 'concerning.'
